text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from grocery shopping
with Chrono Genesis...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, we received a lottery ticket
while we were shopping, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"1 draw for 5 tickets"...
Let's see, I think I had around 3 tickets...
choice_data_list: I've got two, so let's go together.
I have two, so let's put them together.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wah... wow, it fits just right...!
Now Trainer, please spin the rattle...
choice_data_list: No, Chrono, you spin it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Not at all! I'm so sorry.
It's not like I have much confidence
in my luck with raffles anyway...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you have this one.
Come, go ahead...!
choice_data_list: No, no, no, you put up three tickets...!
No, no, no, you put up three tickets...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Either is fine, isn't it~?!
Come on, hurry up or the line will back up!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
Umm...
choice_data_list: I'll do it, then! If I win, it's yours, Chrono.
Then I'll do it! If I win, I'll give it to Chrono.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before Chrono Genesis could stop me,
I hurriedly spun the raffle wheel's lever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible, Trainer-san...
Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There was only one grand prize...
To win it with such low odds...
Trainer, you're truly blessed.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give this to Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"However... I really couldn't possibly
accept something so wonderful from you..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I intended to let you have it from the start,
so please, I'd really like you to take it..."
Even after I told her that, she still hesitated.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: This is something drawn thanks to Trainer's luck, after all...
choice_data_list: Hmm, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right...
In that case, umm......

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: How about... we just split it in half?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's a pair ticket, so...
maybe we could... go together...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No!
I'd just be a bother, wouldn't I...? Please forge—
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me...?
Are you sure you want me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she chose me as her travel companion.
Still, knowing how reserved she is,
she might just be being considerate.
choice_data_list: Then I'll hold onto it for you for now.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Calm down first, then think it over again.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true, neither of us can go
right away, can we...?
Since this is a time when we need to focus on racing...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I understand.
Then I shall leave it in your care for now...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Saying 'together' like that just now...
Did I say something weird...?
How embarrassing...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Trainer surely thinks that my hesitation is the only reason...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Still...
since we went through all the trouble of coming to this hot spring... maybe...)
choice_data_list: ...Chrono?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...!
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(When the time comes, I'll properly invite them...
Without getting shy this time, for real...!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! First prize?
Congratulations.
choice_data_list: Yes! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, please...!
I'd really feel bad accepting
something so magnificent...
choice_data_list: Don't hold back. I don't think I can finish it all on my own anyway.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh... I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... in that case...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text: She cooked and brought soup and side dishes for me...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's just made with whatever leftover vegetables I had for bentos, but...
I gave it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's always nice to have a soup...
So, I made a simple paysanne soup..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And then the marinade...
Both are recipes my father taught me.
choice_data_list: Amazing... It looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, it's nothing.
I just hope it suits your taste...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we dig in?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since there was race-related news that both of them wanted to see,
we decided to eat while watching it.
Doing this somehow feels...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (How heartwarming...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san...
Would you like me to serve you
another bowl of rice?
choice_data_list: Ah, I'll do it myself!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's all right.
We have the rice cooker right here.
It'll be ready in no time...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"—Is about this much... alright?
Here... go ahead."
choice_data_list: …! Thank you

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It kind of... feels like home.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, rather than home...
My parents' house...?
Just normal food eaten at home with family...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It kind of feels like...
a home-cooked dinner you eat every day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed..." I thought.
It ended up being an indescribably
relaxing dinner...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".
choice_data_list: Then I'll give this to Chrono...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um...
A-Are you really sure it's alright?
choice_data_list: Eat plenty and build up your strength!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-If that's the case...!
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Considering the nutritional aspect...
I shall make good use of this...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Carrot rapée, glazed carrots,
deep-fried nibitashi, carrot shirishiri.
And carrot cake...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If I do say so myself,
it's got a really nice variety.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Smells so good!
Everything looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Did Chrono make all of this!?
*drool*...! Just looking at it is making me hungry...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Blast-san...
Would you like to give it a taste...?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!? I'm in, I'm in!
I'll eat as much pork as you've got!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Here you go.
Um... if you don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate your feedback on the flavor...
like which one tasted the best, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to tweak the recipe and make it again, so...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake!
Leave it to me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, when I opened the mini-fridge, there was an unfamiliar container inside.
It had a note attached.

text_block_list.name: Note
text_block_list.text:
"To Trainer,
Thank you very much for the carrots the other day."

text_block_list.name: Note
text_block_list.text:
"I made a menu that's great for boosting immunity, so I'm sharing some with you.
Please enjoy it if you'd like."
choice_data_list: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it there quietly
was probably her way of showing consideration
for how busy I've been...
choice_data_list: That's so Chrono...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the lid of the container, I took a bite of
the carrot dish. It was surprisingly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize... But still...
getting a carrot is pretty lucky, isn't it?
choice_data_list: What a shame... I wanted to give you something better.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, no, please don't say that...!
It has such a lovely color and shine,
and looks really delicious...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Or rather...
Are you truly sure it's alright
for me to accept this...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then... I will gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer-san,
this might actually be a stroke of good luck.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I didn't use up my luck here today... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The prediction for the next race
might just hit the mark...!"
choice_data_list: I-I see... !?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Let us try...
using this carrot
to make our prediction...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
On the palm of the hand, tail pointing down,
stand it vertically...
Then release the holding hand...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If it falls to the right, inside gate...!
If it's left, the outside gate... is coming!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Now... Trainer,
please think of a race on your mind.
Ah... aside from races I'm running in, that is...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll entrust my racing luck to you as well...
Trainer.
Here you go...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I stood the carrot straight up in my palm.
Then, I let go.
choice_data_list: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... this is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it would hit or not...
Thanks to her,
I felt completely energized!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...
Um... tissues... right...
choice_data_list: A-Are you there...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, yes...!
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
This is just what I wanted!
I use these all the time, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis was delighted.
Her kindness and the setting sun warmed my heart...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm really happy, truly!
Your thought alone means more than anything...!
